title: xDrip follower sees compressed bg scale if on mmol/l while master on mg/dl
symptom: A follower using mmol/l sees a compressed blood glucose scale when the master records in mg/dl. The real bg range is shown compressed by a factor of 18, because treatment y values are not scaled.
cause: Treatment y values are not scaled when the master records mg/dl data and the follower runs mmol/l.
evidence_quote: Apparently treatment y values aren't scaled.
